<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">GeoBox</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Represents a bounding rectangle aligned with latitude and longitude.
 Geographic area represented by this would be visualised as a rectangle
 when using a normal cylindrical projection (such as Mercator).
 The box has a maximum span of 360 degrees in longitude and 180 degrees in latitude direction.
 The box with equal values in longitude for the corners is considered as a span of 360 degrees.
 The box is considered empty if the latitude of the <a href="#southWestCorner"><code>southWestCorner</code></a> is larger than the the
 latitude of the <a href="#northEastCorner"><code>northEastCorner</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable

<div class="block"><p>Creates a <code>GeoBox</code> which encompases all coordinates from the list.
 The provided list must contain at least two points.
 The altitude values of the input coordinates are not considered for the result.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geoCoordinates</code> - <p>List of coordinates to encompass inside bounding box.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p><code>GeoBox</code> containing all supplied coordinates, or <code>null</code> if less than two coordinates were provided.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoBox</a>&gt;&nbsp;intersection&#8203;(@NonNull
                                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoBox</a>&nbsp;geoBox)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Computes the intersection with the passed <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a>.
 The altitude values are ignored.
 Limitation: Geo boxes are considered as non-intersecting if they overlap only on a single point, horizontal line or vertical line.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geoBox</code> - <p>Another geo box to check intersection with.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>It will be empty if there is no overlap.
     Otherwise, 1 or more geo boxes covering common area by this and passed <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="intersection(java.util.List)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>intersection</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public static&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoBox</a>&gt;&nbsp;intersection&#8203;(@NonNull
                                                  java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoBox</a>&gt;&nbsp;geoBoxes)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Computes intersection of list of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a> instances.
 The altitude values are ignored.
 Limitation: Geo boxes are considered as non-intersecting if they overlap only on a single point, horizontal line or vertical line.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geoBoxes</code> - <p>List of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a> instances.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>It will be empty if there is no overlap between all the passed <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a> instances.
     Otherwise, 1 or more geo boxes covering common area by all the passed <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geobox" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoBox</code></a> instances.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
